SELECT "monthly"."month" "month", "monthly"."sum_monthly_reve" "trailing_3_month" 
FROM (
  SELECT SUM("orders"."measure_orders_r") OVER (ORDER BY "orders"."datetrunc_utf8__" ASC NULLS LAST ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) "sum_monthly_reve", "orders"."datetrunc_utf8__" "month", "orders"."measure_orders_r" "revenue_usd" 
  FROM (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', timezone('UTC', "orders".ordered_at::timestamptz)) "datetrunc_utf8__", sum(order_total_cents / 100.0) "measure_orders_r" 
    FROM  comparison_orders  AS "orders"
    GROUP BY 1
  ) AS "orders"
  ORDER BY "orders"."datetrunc_utf8__" ASC NULLS LAST
) AS "monthly"
LIMIT 50000
